7de322a0b46744aa74bacab564a0893201c91e87.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
7de322a0b46744aa74bacab564a0893201c91e87.abstract: Describes the probabilistic relevance framework behind text retrieval systems, revisiting the term weighting and document length normalisation of the Okapi BM25 family and comparing it against earlier statistical ranking functions.

50a885925673b9c520695c2b50340b15b1c772bb.abstract: Proposes an open-domain question answering method that retrieves passages from a large corpus with a dense dual-encoder trained end-to-end on question-passage pairs from Wikipedia, and outperforms BM25 substantially.

fd38b6f0f1c130d5b285ff4d870578b78f815144.title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
fd38b6f0f1c130d5b285ff4d870578b78f815144.abstract: Introduces retrieval-augmented language model pre-training, treating a latent document as the output of a differentiable retriever so that retrieval is trained jointly with the language modelling objective, reaching state-of-the-art results on open-domain question answering.

c76e2b1077a847dca478f6411da7086ae1bf6c3d.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
c76e2b1077a847dca478f6411da7086ae1bf6c3d.abstract: Combines a parametric sequence-to-sequence generator with a non-parametric dense retriever over an index of documents, marginalising over retrieved documents at generation time; the variants differ in whether retrieval happens per token or per sequence.

1dbe92610faeef1b5591df15e407969cc77e219d.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
1dbe92610faeef1b5591df15e407969cc77e219d.abstract: Introduces contextualised late interaction over BERT: each token of a document is encoded independently and the query representation is compared against document token embeddings with a MaxSim operator, keeping the retriever end-to-end differentiable.

contexts: Late interaction is compared against BM25 on the MS MARCO passage ranking task.

c40462365fb91cdf7a5b1276ff5d82d4891e27ec.title: Passage Re-ranking with T5
c40462365fb91cdf7a5b1276ff5d82d4891e27ec.abstract: Casts passage re-ranking as a sequence-to-sequence task, training a T5 model to output the relevance of a query-passage pair as the word true or false, which is cheaper to serve than a BERT-style cross-encoder while ranking more accurately.

contexts: We compare our pointwise reranker against a T5 sequence-to-sequence reranker.

f0d55ad67ad153056c4bdeb299d5e08701408834.title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Machine Translation for Document Question Answering
f0d55ad67ad153056c4bdeb299d5e08701408834.abstract: Leverages passage retrieval with a generative encoder-decoder: the top-k passages for a question are concatenated as independent input segments to a single encoder-decoder that produces the answer, avoiding the cost of feeding one long concatenated passage set.

520c52ad400063e452055acd026b5307bc1c6fb0.title: Unsupervised Dense Information Retrieval with Contrastive Learning
520c52ad400063e452055acd026b5307bc1c6fb0.abstract: Trains a dense retriever with a contrastive objective on large batches of unsupervised text using in-batch negatives, producing a general-purpose retriever that transfers to knowledge-intensive tasks without any labelled question-passage pairs.

38ce9bd9884f2ceaccfb73834af4d2dbdb0efa68.abstract: Studies retrieval-augmented language models across tasks and model sizes, training the retriever and the sequence-to-sequence reader end-to-end, and finds that the quality and diversity of the retrieved passages matter more than the raw size of the corpus.

21cfcbfff23f20da212a45084ff807e89713d41e.title: Improving Passage Retrieval with Zero-Shot Question Generation
21cfcbfff23f20da212a45084ff807e89713d41e.abstract: Improves passage retrieval with zero-shot question generation: an instruction-tuned text-to-text model generates a hypothetical document for a query, and that hypothetical document, which need not be factually correct, is used to retrieve real passages.

aafd4694d20bd58b3ef2400cd8181fe1360ba62f.title: Measuring and Narrowing the Compositionality Gap in Language Models
aafd4694d20bd58b3ef2400cd8181fe1360ba62f.abstract: Decomposes a multi-hop question into follow-up questions that are answered sequentially using search engine results, so the final answer is synthesised from explicit intermediate evidence rather than from a single retrieval step.

contexts: Self-Ask decomposes multi-hop questions with search engine calls, which is the closest iterative baseline.
We follow the decomposition setup of Self-Ask for multi-hop question answering.

593405f0fe70da5edb175816c15978a7b396a766.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
593405f0fe70da5edb175816c15978a7b396a766.abstract: Interleaves reasoning traces with task-specific actions in a language model so that external information can be consulted and reasoned over, emitting both the reasoning trace and the action at each step.

contexts: Self-Ask decomposes multi-hop questions with search engine calls, which is the closest iterative baseline.
Retrieved with a pretrained sentence encoder baseline.

7dfb8a6ce8a1459b2c252678a2551610cb685f67.title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
7dfb8a6ce8a1459b2c252678a2551610cb685f67.abstract: Interleaves a retriever with chain-of-thought prompting: retrieved passages are fed back into the language model to generate a chain of thought, and the generated chain of thought selects the next passage to retrieve, forming a closed loop.

contexts: We initialise our retriever from the released dense passage retrieval checkpoint.
Retrieval-augmented generation with a fixed retriever is our strongest baseline.
We evaluate against multi-step retrieval baselines for query decomposition.

dc3afbd8e4e5c09194dfef0a3eee54a8598ed69c.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
dc3afbd8e4e5c09194dfef0a3eee54a8598ed69c.abstract: Active retrieval augmented generation uses the model to forecast the sentence it is about to generate, then compares that forecast against candidate passages to obtain a confidence signal that decides when a retrieval query should actually be issued.

contexts: We follow the decomposition setup of Self-Ask for multi-hop question answering.
Active retrieval augmented generation sits on top of a standard retrieval-augmented generation pipeline.

20153ab0fc2baf18a2b3d06f100f9b162cc26039.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
20153ab0fc2baf18a2b3d06f100f9b162cc26039.abstract: Proposes reference-free evaluation of retrieval-augmented generation with an LLM-as-judge setup, scoring faithfulness and answer relevance from the generated answer plus retrieved contexts, and context precision and recall from the retrieved contexts alone.

eeae36623067d8b96efa617c3100a4680deba2a9.title: Chain-of-Note: Enhancing Robustness in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
eeae36623067d8b96efa617c3100a4680deba2a9.abstract: Enhances the robustness of retrieval-augmented language models against noisy retrieved documents by adding explicit notes that summarise the key information in the retrieved documents to the prompt, so the model can reason about whether the notes actually answer the question.

contexts: We measure the robustness of a standard retrieval-augmented language model to noisy retrieved documents.
Chain-of-note prompting is a related approach to handling noisy retrieval.

ff0c8d1946af9c38072dbccdb3b062c7efe67aa6.title: Query Expansion with Large Language Models
ff0c8d1946af9c38072dbccdb3b062c7efe67aa6.abstract: Expands queries using large language models by generating a short hypothetical passage for each query and training a dense retriever to place the query close to that passage, which improves first-stage retrieval without labels.

a2f949413379ade92d461bd685902e21d4b9648d.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
a2f949413379ade92d461bd685902e21d4b9648d.abstract: Trains a retriever and a generator with a reflection token that lets the model decide on demand whether to retrieve and whether each retrieved passage and each generated segment is relevant, so retrieval is skipped when the parametric knowledge already suffices.

332cf74c354ca1cb0e7ff8ae3d29f52e5f5103bc.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
332cf74c354ca1cb0e7ff8ae3d29f52e5f5103bc.abstract: Shows that language models use long input contexts poorly: performance on multi-document question answering and synthetic key-value retrieval degrades sharply when the relevant information sits in the middle of the input rather than at the start or the end.

contexts: We discuss the limits of stuffing retrieved passages into a long context.

a16718999598de878de64dde5d05fe1837e81627.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
a16718999598de878de64dde5d05fe1837e81627.abstract: Corrective retrieval augmented generation adds a lightweight retrieval evaluator to detect and correct incorrect retrievals: a query judged relevant-poor triggers a web search, and retrieved documents are decomposed and reranked into a more reliable evidence set.

fd205c688c9fa88ec252e4d24c03fc44b6dc8eb9.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
fd205c688c9fa88ec252e4d24c03fc44b6dc8eb9.abstract: Recursive abstractive processing for tree-organized retrieval builds a corpus tree by recursively clustering passages and summarising each cluster, so retrieval can operate at several levels of abstraction and answer both specific and global questions.

contexts: Long-context baselines are evaluated under the setting documented by Liu et al.

01904af228e24a08a9ba8d79d074e7cf48d21532.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
01904af228e24a08a9ba8d79d074e7cf48d21532.abstract: Builds an entity knowledge graph over a corpus, precomputes community summaries with graph community detection, and maps a query onto a set of relevant communities so that global sensemaking questions can be answered, at a much higher token cost than local vector search.

contexts: We contrast graph-based indexing with query-side generative augmentation.

fdf5759dd97783623e1521e011c1c8aa1c536a5c.title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs
fdf5759dd97783623e1521e011c1c8aa1c536a5c.abstract: Unsupervised fine-tunes a single LLM as both a pointwise passage reranker and a listwise generator, distilling the LLM's own ranking knowledge so that one model handles both reranking retrieved passages and generating the final grounded answer.

68fabd35248133e555e61b89f26cd924ebe296ea.title: Generation-Augmented Retrieval (GAR): Improving Dense Retrieval with Generative Knowledge
68fabd35248133e555e61b89f26cd924ebe296ea.abstract: Generation-augmented retrieval uses the language model's parametric knowledge as a supplement to the corpus: the query is augmented with generated knowledge that is fused with the query embedding for retrieval, which helps tail queries where corpus evidence is weak.
